title: About Me
subtitle: Craft, clarity, and production excellence
summary: I am a Senior Flutter Developer and Mobile Engineer with 4+ years of experience designing, developing, and shipping high-performance mobile applications used by millions.

At Real11 Fantasy Sports, I helped scale a skill-based entertainment platform to 10M+ downloads and 100K+ daily active users — integrating real-time Socket.IO systems, Stripe & Razorpay payments, in-app purchases, and an observability pipeline that cut crash rates by 28% and lifted 30-day retention by 40%.

I specialize in Clean Architecture, MVVM, and BLoC, with deep hands-on experience across Firebase, REST APIs, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and publishing to both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store. I am also expanding as a Full Stack Developer with Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and React — bringing end-to-end ownership from mobile UI to backend services.
